verdict.rationale: Jules provides checkpoint-based status updates (plan approval, diff review, completion/needs-input notifications) but no documented live activity feed or continuous real-time view of what the agent is doing; a community comment even notes there's no 'stop' button to interrupt a running session, suggesting limited real-time oversight tooling. missing for 10: documented live log/activity stream, real-time status indicator UI, independent hands-on confirmation of watching live agent actions.
